draft.title: Methods

paragraphs.text: We statically read TutorialBalance.front_rate and its exact source lines without importing the module. The balance in {{equation:balance}} has an illustrative front capacity of {{value:capacity}}. The independently chosen CSV states do not result from executing that balance. At each record we subtract rear from front, then use trapezoidal time weights over 0–5 s; no native solver event is inferred.
